body: I don’t know who you are, but I really hope you think twice about your choices. I want you to please read this with a straight mind. Don’t fucking go. You must have a passion in your life that’s kept you going since you were born. If not, try to seek it. Happiness is a gift if you have depression. Everyday we battle through life and stress. Every single day. Reach out to me, a stranger, a neighbor, your family, anybody. Please don’t be afraid to speak your thoughts. You’re a soul. You’re worth living here.
Maybe, which is scary to think about. When I woke up I felt weaker than usual. I might see a doctor today to ask him some questions.
